evidence: The LiPON thin films were deposited using an F-120 flow-type hot-wall ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry Ltd.) from lithium hexamethyldisilazide LiN(SiMe3)2 (LiHMDS) and diethyl phosphoramidate H2NP(O)(OC2H5)2 (DEPA) precursors. Nitrogen (99.999%) was used both as a carrier and purging gas with a flow rate of 300 sccm.
